description: This file contains unit tests for the AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory class, specifically testing its behavior against different SQL databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL). It includes test classes for each database type and an abstract base class with various test methods verifying adapter creation, cache retrieval, and queue mapper functionality.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory against SQL Server.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory against MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Test class for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactoryTests
classes.description: Abstract base class containing common tests for AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory, parameterized by database type.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by setting up the relational storage instance and connection string.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_CreatesAdapter
methods.description: Verifies that the factory creates a valid AdoNetQueueAdapter instance with correct properties.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_GetsDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Checks that the factory provides an AdoNetStreamFailureHandler with expected configuration.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_GetsQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Ensures the factory returns a SimpleQueueAdapterCache instance.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_GetsStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Verifies that the factory returns a HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper instance.

methods.name: AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory_ConstructsViaStaticFactory
methods.description: Tests the static factory method for creating an AdoNetQueueAdapterFactory.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for async disposal, currently does nothing.
